description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'SetFont' that provides static methods to change the font style (plain or bold) and size for Swing GUI components within the 'com.romraider.swing' package.

classes.name: SetFont
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for modifying the font style and size of Swing components.

methods.name: SetFont()
methods.description: Default constructor for the SetFont utility class.

methods.name: plain(JComponent component)
methods.description: Sets the font of the component to plain style with its current font size.

methods.name: plain(JComponent component, int size)
methods.description: Sets the font of the component to plain style with a specified size.

methods.name: bold(JComponent component)
methods.description: Sets the font of the component to bold style with its current font size.

methods.name: bold(JComponent component, int size)
methods.description: Sets the font of the component to bold style with a specified size.
